question: Can the sense of rotation of a convection roll in a liquid layer heated from below hold a written bit?

provenance.source: Saltzman, J. Atmos. Sci. 19, 329 (1962); Lorenz, J. Atmos. Sci. 20, 130 (1963): three-mode truncation of the Boussinesq equations for a layer heated from below, free-slip boundaries

name: convection roll (Lorenz-Saltzman)

carrier.name: roll amplitude X, temperature mode Y and distortion Z of the mean temperature profile

closure: one roll mode at the critical wavenumber with its temperature mode and the distortion of the horizontally averaged temperature (Saltzman truncation); thermal fluctuations enter as additive noise
observable: sign of X: the sense of rotation of the roll
assumptions: free-slip top and bottom boundaries; wavenumber at the critical value, b = 8/3
r is the Rayleigh number in units of its critical value
additive Gaussian noise of fixed strength
